page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.48xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor with an x86_64 architecture running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to support high-throughput networking requirements. The lack of integrated GPUs and local NVMe storage represents a design tradeoff, prioritizing raw CPU compute density and network performance over local storage speed or hardware-accelerated graphics processing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high core density offer a predictable performance profile for compute-heavy workloads without the overhead of unused local storage or GPU resources. The instance is suited for high-performance computing, batch processing, large-scale web serving, and compute-intensive simulation workloads that require massive parallel processing capabilities.
